note_zcs: zcs = |i| at the actual turn-off instant (end of the last on-step) / I_pk. E1 reported |i| at the start of the last 20 ns on-step (zcs_E1_convention = 4.38 %), which samples the current 20 ns before turn-off and overstates it by about I_pk*w*20ns. With the same model at dt = 5 ns the at-instant value is unchanged (2.66 %).
